method: a genuine Avito item page of a private ad (its owner reports it sold) rendered in the operator's Chrome over raw CDP on 2026-11-06 14:30 MSK (page.content() via avito_card's own fetch; the page has no schema.org Product); trimmed to the title element, the item-view/closed-warning banner (captured nesting, generated attributes stripped) and window.__staticRouterHydrationData reduced to buyerItem.closedItem, closedItemStatus, item.isActive and item.isClosed, each copied from the capture. De-identified: listing id, URL and title are fictional; no seller, description, photo or location data kept

ground_truth.note: a closed ad: closedItem=true, closedItemStatus «Объявление снято с публикации.», item.isClosed=true, isActive=false and the banner with the same text; the buyer page does not say whether it was sold; avito_card answers not_found with that text
